description: Analysis code, per-neuron measurements, statistics (tables S1–S11) and figures for the manuscript 'Neuronal birth order leaves a reproducible trace in the geometry of three Drosophila connectomes' (submitted to Biology Letters). The analyses test a site-of-addition rule, under which a neuron's age grows with its distance from the site where its lineage adds new cells, in the MaleCNS v1.0, FlyWire v783 and BANC v888 connectomes, with MANC v1.0 for connectivity. Version 2.0.0 adds the folder biolett/; the files of version 1.0.0 (MaleCNS only, an earlier version of the manuscript) are kept unchanged.
